chk_oi_quantity_matches_basis.name: chk_oi_quantity_matches_basis
chk_oi_quantity_matches_basis.value: ("order_items"."pricing_basis" = 'per_item' AND "order_items"."quantity_pieces" > 0 AND "order_items"."weight_grams" IS NULL) OR ("order_items"."pricing_basis" = 'per_kg' AND "order_items"."weight_grams" > 0 AND "order_items"."quantity_pieces" IS NULL)

chk_tax_rates_split_valid.name: chk_tax_rates_split_valid
chk_tax_rates_split_valid.value: ("tax_rates"."is_exempt" = 1 AND "tax_rates"."total_rate_bps" = 0 AND "tax_rates"."cgst_rate_bps" = 0 AND "tax_rates"."sgst_rate_bps" = 0 AND "tax_rates"."igst_rate_bps" = 0) OR ("tax_rates"."is_exempt" = 0 AND "tax_rates"."cgst_rate_bps" + "tax_rates"."sgst_rate_bps" = "tax_rates"."total_rate_bps" AND "tax_rates"."igst_rate_bps" = "tax_rates"."total_rate_bps")
